title: 第17章 我测金丹第18章 把天赋带到玄清界
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “行了，匪徒都完蛋了，已经安全了。”
陈昭一把揪起芙兰卡后脖颈的衣服，把她从地上提了起来。
看着已经被斩杀的两个头头，芙兰卡陷入了震惊。
“其他人呢？”
“在灌木丛里”
陈昭耸了耸肩，指了指那底下不断渗出红色液体的灌木丛，处理周遭的匪徒总得找个藏匿的地方不是？
“嗨呀！”
得知安全了，芙兰卡顿时泄了口气，旋即又瘫软的坐在地上，哇哇哭起来，一边哭着一边为没能及时还钱道歉，哭诉自己全部的家当都被抢走，无法赎回那枚储物戒指了。
对于那车被运走的货币，陈昭其实没什么所谓，又不是急缺的灵石，倒是这几车的货物收获巨大，仅仅粗略的观察了下，不光有陈昭想要的炼体药材，还有一套炼金术师所用的器材。
陈昭一直有想学习炼药方向，如今更是有了火属性灵根，炼丹材料手里也都有，就差一套用来炼药的器皿了。
本想去玄清界采购一番炼药鼎之类的器具，如今得了这炼金器皿也不是不能用。
说到底，这炼丹无非就是去除杂质萃取药力，用灵气火焰细心控制焚烧掉杂质是一种萃取方法，用适配的溶液溶解萃取药力不也是一种萃取方法？谁说液体药就一定比固态药差的，反而更好吸收好吧！
不过缺点大概就是不易储存和携带不便了吧，毕竟丹药一类的产物往往放在玉质的盒子之中防止其药力散失，这玉质的盒子好找，这玉质的瓶子可难找。
即便是找到了那种玉质小瓶，可人家小瓶内装丹药的话能装几十粒，装药液的话，一瓶所蕴含的药力很明显是比不过同样体积几十粒丹药的。
而且修士修为上升之后，斗法胜负往往取决于分毫间的破绽，固态丹药固然需要消耗精力去炼化，但吃药的过程却很短暂，露出的破绽也自然更少。
液体丹药却是无法避免饮用时的长时间，除非能将液体丹药浓缩成一颗略大的液球，便于在斗法时如吃下固态丹药一般一口吞下，否则还是弊大于利的。
或者来说，可以试着将药液储存在针管之中，长期扎在身上，遇到需要的时候只需神识一动便可直接注入体内，可仔细想来，这套方法也不具备很强的实践性，不说这外置的设备需要时刻注意保护，应对突发情况的效果可能也不如提前吞下些许丹药藏于腹中，需要时直接炼化。
这么想来，还是要往固体丹药方向发展吧！
不过用这炼金术师的器材去大火收汁说不定也能行，反正现在手头药材众多，便是是先前修炼到炼气圆满消耗掉了许多，现在也依旧有十几捆，到时候放心去实验吧！
等下，这些好像都是这芙兰卡的东西吧。
陈昭有些尴尬的摸了摸鼻子。
俺还以为没人要呢，不小心给拾走嘞。
现在正主就在旁边，倒是陈昭有些不太好意思了。
刚想开口，只感觉远处传来一阵熟悉的压迫感
“我测，金丹”
感知到一股强横气息从天边席卷而来，陈昭想都没想丢下芙兰卡拔腿就跑。
content_en:
"Okay, the gangsters are all gone and it's safe."
Chen Zhao grabbed Franka's clothes at the back of her neck and lifted her up from the ground.
"Huh?"
Looking at the two leaders who had been killed, Franka was shocked.
"Where are the others?"
"In the bush"
Chen Zhao shrugged and pointed to the bushes that were constantly leaking red liquid. He had to find a hiding place to deal with the gangsters around him, right?
"Hi!"
After learning that she was safe, Franka immediately let out a sigh of relief, and immediately sat down on the ground, crying. While crying, she apologized for not being able to pay back the money in time, and cried that all her belongings had been robbed and she could no longer redeem the storage ring.
Chen Zhao actually didn't care about the currency that was transported in the cart. It wasn't spiritual stones that were in urgent need, but the goods in these carts were a huge harvest. After just a cursory inspection, there were not only the body refining herbs that Chen Zhao wanted, but also a set of equipment used by alchemists.
Chen Zhao has always wanted to learn the direction of refining medicine, and now he has a fire-attribute spiritual root. He also has the materials for refining elixirs. All he needs is a set of utensils for refining medicine.
I originally wanted to go to the Xuanqing Realm to purchase some equipment such as the alchemy cauldron, but now that I have this alchemy vessel, it is not impossible to use it.
In the final analysis, this alchemy is nothing more than removing impurities to extract medicinal power. Using spiritual energy flames to carefully control the burning of impurities is an extraction method. Isn't using a suitable solution to dissolve and extract medicinal power also an extraction method? Who says that liquid medicines are necessarily worse than solid medicines? On the contrary, they are better absorbed!
However, the disadvantage is probably that it is difficult to store and carry. After all, products such as elixirs are often placed in jade boxes to prevent their potency from being lost. This jade box is easy to find, but this jade bottle is difficult to find.
Even if you find that kind of jade vial, if the vial is filled with pills, it can hold dozens of pills. If it is filled with liquid medicine, the potency contained in one bottle is obviously not as powerful as dozens of pills of the same volume.
Moreover, after a monk's cultivation level rises, the outcome of a battle often depends on the slightest flaw. Although solid elixirs require energy to be refined, the process of taking the medicine is very short, and naturally fewer flaws are exposed.
Liquid elixirs cannot avoid drinking for a long time. Unless the liquid elixir can be concentrated into a slightly larger liquid ball, which can be swallowed in one gulp like a solid elixir during a fight, it will still do more harm than good.
Alternatively, you can try to store the medicinal liquid in a needle and stick it on the body for a long time. When needed, it can be directly injected into the body with just a movement of consciousness. However, if you think about it carefully, this method is not very practical. Not to mention that the external equipment needs to be protected at all times. The effect of dealing with emergencies may not be as good as swallowing some elixirs in advance and hiding them in your belly, and refining them directly when needed.
Thinking about it this way, we should develop in the direction of solid elixirs!
However, it might be possible to use this alchemist's equipment to collect the juice from the fire. Anyway, there are many medicinal materials on hand now. Even though I have consumed a lot of them during my previous cultivation to the perfection of Qi refining, there are still more than a dozen bundles, so feel free to experiment when the time comes!
Wait, these seem to be Franka's things.
Chen Zhao touched his nose awkwardly.
I thought no one wanted it and it was accidentally picked up.
Now that the real owner is nearby, Chen Zhao feels a little embarrassed.
Just as I was about to speak, I felt a familiar sense of oppression coming from the distance.
"I'll test it, golden elixir"
Sensing a powerful aura sweeping in from the horizon, Chen Zhao ran away without even thinking about leaving Franka behind.
------
title_en: Chapter 17 I Test the Golden Pill Chapter 18 Bringing Talent to the Xuanqing Realm
